paper.title: Transitivity Meets Cyclicity: Explicit Preference Decomposition for Dynamic Large Language Model Alignment

claims.claim_boundary: Five exact-rational finite seven-strategy skew-symmetric games under a uniform discrete measure reconstruct exactly with zero cyclic marginal and zero orthogonality residual. This does not establish the universal theorem for arbitrary functions, measures, or embedding assumptions.
No HRC Bradley-Terry plus GPM-style fit, held-out preference audit, embedding construction, or constraint check is present.
claims.planned_producer: Pin the data and embeddings, fit or load the scalar reward and skew-symmetric bilinear form, and audit held-out pairwise preferences.

claims.claim_boundary: No RewardBench 2 Gemma-2B-it checkpoint, task data, prompt, training run, or result artifact is reproduced.
claims.planned_producer: Pin the benchmark version, checkpoint, objective, seeds, evaluator, and task-level raw outputs before comparing HRC, BT, and GPM.

claims.claim_boundary: No RewardBench 2 Llama-3.1-8B checkpoint or paper-faithful comparison is reproduced.
claims.planned_producer: Use the same pinned protocol as Claim 3 and retain task-level metrics, aggregation, uncertainty, and baseline configuration.

claims.claim_boundary: No HRC+DSPPO training, AlpacaEval 2.0, Arena-Hard-v0.1, or MT-Bench result is reproduced.
claims.planned_producer: Pin policy checkpoints, preference data, DSPPO schedule, decoding, reference models, evaluators, prompts, and raw judged outputs.

claims.claim_boundary: No dynamic-game implementation, duality-gap trace, assumption audit, or O(1/sqrt(T)) convergence-rate reproduction is present.
claims.planned_producer: Implement the time-varying score schedule with explicit realizability, bounded-score, approximation-error, step-size, and average-policy checks.
